subject: EmberBridge integration technical fit review and smoke validation
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@emberbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed validation workshop + reference design (EmberBridge x Redwood)

Hi Kimberly / Laura / Sergio —

Thanks again for the demo last week. EmberBridge had a productive internal sync and we'd like to propose a short technical validation workshop to confirm integration points and run a light smoke validation against a staging tenant. High-level goals:

- Confirm SSO / SAML flow for the private deployment option
- Validate API compatibility for streaming and routed fallbacks
- Exercise model variant fallback with our connector under load (50–200 RPS short blast)
- Surface any required schema changes for telemetry/tracing

I attached a short pre-validation checklist and a reference architecture diagram. Can your team share a preferred time window next week (EDT) and a contact for infra/runtime tests?

Proposed attendees from our side: myself (Eng lead), Tariq (integration eng), and one of our infra folks.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EmberBridge-Integration-Docs
Attachments: emberbridge-prevalidation-checklist.pdf, emberbridge-reference-arch.v1.drawio.svg

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

— Nora
Nora Patel
Head of Integrations, EmberBridge Solutions
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@emberbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed validation workshop + reference design (EmberBridge x Redwood)

Nora — great, thanks for the clear plan and the checklist.

We can run a focused validation session. Quick answers up front:
- Preferred window: Tue/Thu next week 10:00–12:00 EDT (we can do 90 minutes to leave time for runbook review)
- Runtime contact: Aditya Rao (cc'd) will lead the smoke tests and throughput blasts
- We will need a staging API key and a transient test tenant with sample telemetry enabled so we can validate tracing headers and cost metrics.

Two asks from our side before the workshop:
1) Can you confirm the exact SAML metadata URL for your IdP (or a test metadata blob)?
2) If you plan to exercise fallback routing, please share the model variants you expect to call and any rate limits you enforce on the connector side.

We'll prep a short test plan and share it by Monday EOD. I've attached a Redwood checklist we'll use to map your items to our runbook.

Regards,

Kimberly Park
Director, Partner Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-integration-checklist.pdf (sent internally to coord prep)
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@emberbridge.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed validation workshop + reference design (EmberBridge x Redwood)

On Thu, May 20, 2027 at 3:12 PM Nora Patel <nora.patel@emberbridge.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo last week. EmberBridge had a productive internal sync and we'd like to propose a short technical validation workshop to confirm integration points and run a light smoke validation against a staging tenant.

Nora — following up to lock this in. A couple of operational notes from Redwood's side:

- For the throughput blast we'll run from Redwood Dedicated test capacity (isolated). Aditya: we'll need to coordinate the exact window and whether EmberBridge will originate the requests or if we proxy traffic to you.
- Please confirm whether EmberBridge honors the X-Redwood-Tracing header and forwards our span IDs; tracing propagation is required for our observability checks.
- Security: EmberBridge's prevalidation doc mentions IP allowlist. If you have ephemeral IP ranges for the test tenant, please add Redwood Dedicated staging CIDR: 10.24.128.0/20 (we'll provide precise CIDRs in a second email).

Also, Laura — can you add a short checklist item to confirm that the partner onboarding PS team has visibility into the audit logs? We occasionally see mismatches in retention settings when partners use their own telemetry sinks.

Sergio
Senior Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Tariq Hassan <tariq.hassan@emberbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nora Patel <nora.patel@emberbridge.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed validation workshop + reference design (EmberBridge x Redwood)

Kimberly / Sergio — thanks for the details. Quick answers and what we'll bring to the workshop: 

- SAML metadata (test): https://emberbridge.com/test-idp/saml-metadata.xml (we'll also drop the blob in the Drive folder)
- Model variants: ember-2b, ember-7b-quant, ember-14b-fp16. We'll supply a small harness that can request these variants; rate-limits are lenient for partner tests (500 RPS max, we recommend short bursts).
- Tracing: we honor X-Redwood-Tracing and will forward span IDs to our observability pipeline.
- IP allowlist: we'll add 10.24.128.0/20 to the staging tenant for the scheduled window and confirm via the Drive note.

We attached a short runbook and a minimal synthetic dataset for the smoke test. For the smoke validation itself, would you prefer EmberBridge to originate traffic (we can use our harness) or Redwood to push requests through to EmberBridge? We can support either; EmberBridge-originated traffic simplifies correlation on our side.

DocuSign / contract note: we also wanted to confirm the scope of logs/metrics we can access for debugging — we've raised a short SOW addendum that we'd like legal to sign off before the production rollover. We'll share the DocuSign link after the workshop if the smoke pass looks good.

— Tariq
Tariq Hassan
Integration Engineer, EmberBridge Solutions
Attachments: emberbridge-runbook-v1.pdf, emberbridge-synthetic-samples.tar.gz
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@emberbridge.com>, Tariq Hassan <tariq.hassan@emberbridge.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed validation workshop + reference design (EmberBridge x Redwood)

Thanks — that all sounds good. Final logistics: 

- Workshop scheduled: Thu, 27 May 2027, 10:30–12:00 EDT (90m). Calendar invites sent to all.
- We will originate the throughput blasts from Redwood Dedicated staging; Aditya will coordinate a short smoke harness to run ember-7b-quant and ember-14b-fp16 variants in 3 x 60s bursts.
- EmberBridge to confirm SAML blob and verify IP allowlist by EOD tomorrow.
- Post-workshop: if smoke passes, please share the SOW addendum link (Jira PARTNER-4821 will track legal).

Action items:
- Aditya: prepare test harness + timeline (by Wed EOD)
- Nora/Tariq: confirm SAML + IP allowlist (by Wed EOD)
- Sergio/Laura: ensure onboarding PS has audit-log access verification in the runbook

Looking forward — we'll run a brief readout at the end of the session and capture any architectural changes needed for production routing.

Cheers,

Kim
Director, Partner Engineering, Redwood Inference
